description: Cross-feed compute isolation: the SAME materialized batch + SAME weights (pi05_base_pytorch_new) + SAME noise/time + train=True/rng=None is fed through BOTH the RLinf Pi0 and the reference openpi.models_pytorch_new.Pi0; loss + global grad norm are compared. Holding data/weights/noise/time/dtype/train-mode identical isolates COMPUTE. Source: tools/sft_grad_parity_probe.py (reference dump in the reference venv + RLinf grads).
conclusion: On the identical batch+weights+noise/time, the two models' loss agrees to <= 0.00050 and global grad norm to rel <= 0.0028 (~0.2%); per-module grad norms and #params-with-grad also match. The model forward+backward is byte-identical (RLinf vendored the reference), so COMPUTE is ruled out as the cause of the first-step loss/grad gap.
